Title: SONAM EA graduate nursing student intends to give back
NewsSummary: Navish Aleem talks about her motivation to pursue her master's in nursing at AKUSONA EA after completing her undergraduate in nursing at AKU-Karachi, Pakistan.compling

content.text: Navish Aleem's journey into nursing wasn't a typical one. At first, a nursing career seemed like a pipe dream, as her grades were not good enough to apply to medical school. However, this did not deter her; she applied to AKU in Pakistan, graduated with an undergraduate degree, and is now pursuing a Master of Science in Advanced Practice Nursing degree at AKUSONAM EA.

"The fact that I am doing my master's shows how much I am into nursing, and I love it!" she says. She practiced for four years in Karachi before moving to AKU in Nairobi to pursue her postgraduate education. The course is unique and is hardly offered by any other university. It is designed to prepare advanced practice nurses to develop innovative, practical solutions to complex health problems from a scientific perspective.

Aleem's education at AKU has been a 'life-changing experience'. She has learned a lot of new skills, such as the importance of communication with patients and the art of research. Her education at AKU has not only changed her as a nurse but also the way she sees her job.

"As an AKU graduate student, I can see the difference in quality care towards the patient. I have put into practice the skills I've learned, including the importance of washing hands before and after interacting with patients and proper documentation."

The faculty have also had a significant impact on Aleem's education. Together with her colleagues, they have been a source of support. "All the girls in my class are my friends. They are very supportive. If I am missing my family or if I am feeling homesick, they will support me, and they are open to communicating and talking about my feelings."

Her career goal is to practice abroad, then return to her home country, Pakistan, to give back to her community. "Giving back to the community is a mission for the Aga Khan University, and that is what I will do. AKU has groomed me well for my future and given me the confidence to pursue my dreams."

This year, International Nurses Day reminded us how essential it is to recognize the hard work and dedication of nurses like Aleem. As Aleem puts it, "Nurses should be continuously appreciated, not only when there is a crisis. We work for long hours, so our efforts should not go unnoticed."
